messages:
raj: Quick heads-up — change window tonight 01:00 UTC. Plan: pin runtime v2.4.2 and api v1.8.1. Console will only flip a feature flag. Need a router compatibility sanity for the kernel header reorder before freeze. @emma @router-eng can you run a smoke? deploy-bot will kick a dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled in 20m. Freeze enforced 10m before window. No DB migrations.

emma: Staging smoke saw brief upstream 502s when runtime switched to quantized batching. Snippet: `router: upstream 502 - header-order unexpected (meta,flags) vs (flags,meta)`

router-eng: We can add a short-lived tolerant parser (`router.legacy_header_accept=true`) and canary to one shard. No schema changes.

raj: Rollback play: if 5xx >0.7% for 5m -> rollback runtime to v2.4.1 first. If still failing, flip router tolerance, then consider router rollback. @sre-oncall confirm alerting?

sre-oncall: Affirm. Creating alert: 5xx >0.7% for 5m -> notify #incidents and page PD. Attaching runbook with rollout/rollback steps.

console-eng: We'll add a banner and a telemetry probe that pings the header order. Also add `router.legacy_header_accept=true` to release notes if we enable it.

router-eng: Can canary shim to shard-5 now (1/1). Watching p95 and 5xx; update in ~5m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete, canary started (1/1). Full rollout estimated 15m after green.

emma: Canary stable. Slight p95 bump (~25ms) on KV hot path, no client 5xx. Ready to proceed.

raj: Locking pin window 01:00-01:20 UTC. Draft release note: "runtime v2.4.2 - batching perf; api v1.8.1 - header parsing loosening; router - optional legacy header accept (auto-expire 30m)."

router-eng: Shim set to auto-expire 30m post-rollout. Tagging rollout metadata `#legacy-header`.

sre-oncall: Pager on standby. Escalate per alert.

raj: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread for signals and rollback ops.
